name: Creamy Caesar Dressing
ingredientsText: SOYBEAN OIL, WATER, DISTILLED VINEGAR, SUGAR, SALT, PARMESAN CHEESE (PASTEURIZED PART SKIM MILK, CHEESE CULTURES, SALT, ENZYMES), WHEY, EGG YOLKS 2%, MODIFIED CORN STARCH, ANCHOVIES, DRIED GARLIC, SPICES, XANTHAN GUM, SOY SAUCE (WATER, WHEAT, SOYBEANS, SALT, SODIUM BENZOATE [PRESERVATIVE]), DRIED ONION, NATURAL FLAVOR, LEMON JUICE CONCENTRATE, SOY FLOUR, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, CALCIUM DISODIUM EDTA.
notes: Wheat comes only from inside the soy sauce sub-ingredients. Anchovies are fish.
